observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show a pair of car headlight assemblies wrapped in clear plastic film, sitting on a concrete floor.
Each headlight has an amber/orange turn-signal section and a clear lens section, consistent with an older sedan-style headlight.
A semi-transparent watermark reading 'LINUS AUTO LIGHT SOLUTION' is overlaid on all three photos; this is added text, not a label on the part itself.
No visible manufacturer logo, part number, or model sticker is legible on the headlight housings in any photo.
Mounting clips/brackets are visible on the back of the units but no identifying text is readable there either.
A second, different-looking headlight edge is visible in the bottom of photo 0 and the right edge of photo 2, suggesting more than one pair/model is present in the seller's stock.
No photo shows the lights powered on, no photo shows bulbs or wiring harness, and no photo shows the lens unwrapped for a clear view of scratches or cracks.

claims.evidence: No shipping, customs, or origin documentation shown in any photo; condition/origin cannot be confirmed from a floor photo.
No Honda logo, part number, or OEM marking is legible on the headlight housing in photos 0, 1, or 2; only the seller's watermark text mentions no brand at all.
Subjective marketing term; no comparative or spec photo provided.
Only one pair (plus a possible second partial unit) is shown; no catalog or stock photo of other models provided.

risks.risk: Headlight may not illuminate or have internal electrical faults.
risks.proof: A short video clip showing the headlight connected to a battery/power source and lighting up.

risks.risk: Exact Honda model/year fitment is unknown, which is critical since headlights are not universal.
risks.proof: A clear, well-lit photo of the part number sticker or OEM connector tag on the back of the housing.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown-fitment generic unit, not model-specific

risks.risk: Lens or housing may be cracked, cloudy, or sun-damaged under the plastic wrap.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the unwrapped lens from multiple angles in good light.

risks.risk: Set may be incomplete (missing bulbs, wiring harness, or mounting hardware).
risks.proof: Photo showing bulbs installed and wiring pigtail/connector attached.

risks.risk: 'Tokunbo' claim of genuine overseas-used origin vs. a cheaper aftermarket/locally-refurbished copy cannot be checked.
risks.proof: Photo of any OEM Honda part number or factory stamp molded into the plastic housing.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the part number or Honda logo stamped/molded on the headlight housing or connector.
Video of the headlight powered on showing both low and high beam, plus turn signal, functioning.
Unwrapped close-up photos of each lens from front and side to check for cracks, fog, or yellowing.
Photo confirming bulbs and wiring harness are included with the unit.
response.reason: The item type is clear (a pair of headlight assemblies) but no model, year, or even a legible brand mark is visible in any photo, and fitment is the dominant price driver for auto parts; without a readable part number or model-confirming shot, not even a worst-case price tier can be set.
